Full camp (all 15 tents) booking: one person travels complimentary on full board accommodation only, and can accommodate 6 additional drivers.
Conservancy Entrance fees NOT included in accommodation rates - billed separately.
Camp has 15 luxury tents (500-600 sq ft); 6 with outdoor bath tubs, 1 with outdoor Jacuzzi; tents 1-9 overlook a watering hole.
